## Usage

Install once in R:

```{r}
#| eval: false
install.packages(c("rstac", "sf", "knitr"))
```

1. Edit the polygon, the dates and the destination in the first code block and render. With `ids <- character()` it only queries: the table and the plot of the available scenes are shown, and nothing is downloaded.
2. Check the table and the plot. Copy the chosen **product_id**.
3. Assign, for example, `ids <- "LC08_L2SP_232083_20160209_20200907_02_T1"`
   and render again. Several IDs from the table can be included.

Search and download from
[Microsoft Planetary Computer](https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/dataset/landsat-c2-l2)
are public: no account is needed. The URLs are signed automatically with a
temporary token (SAS) provided by Planetary Computer itself.

Only **Collection 2 Level-2** products (collection `landsat-c2-l2`) are
downloaded, as complete scenes, without cropping or reprojecting. Each product is stored in
`<dest>/<product_id>/` with all its GeoTIFF files and the `*_MTL.txt` metadata,
keeping the original USGS names. Files that were already downloaded are not
downloaded again.

For more information on the scenes and their processing:
<https://www.usgs.gov/landsat-missions/landsat-collection-2-level-2-science-products>

## Parameters

```{r}
library(rstac)
library(sf)

from <- as.Date("2016-02-08")
to   <- as.Date("2016-02-10")
ids  <- character()  # e.g. "LC08_L2SP_232083_20160209_20200907_02_T1"
dest <- "../../L8"

# AOI Mendoza, vertices in UTM 19S (EPSG:32619); the first one is repeated to close the ring
vertices <- matrix(c(
  500000, -3660000,
  526000, -3660000,
  526000, -3644000,
  500000, -3644000,
  500000, -3660000
), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)
aoi <- st_transform(st_sfc(st_polygon(list(vertices)), crs = 32619), 4326)

stopifnot(from <= to, all(st_is_valid(aoi)))
```

## Search scenes

```{r}
items <- stac("https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/api/stac/v1") |>
  stac_search(
    collections = "landsat-c2-l2",
    bbox = as.vector(st_bbox(aoi)),
    datetime = paste0(from, "T00:00:00Z/", to, "T23:59:59Z"),
    limit = 100
  ) |>
  post_request() |>
  items_fetch()

# Only Landsat 8 and 9 (OLI/TIRS)
scenes <- Filter(function(x) grepl("^LC0[89]_", x$id), items$features)
if (!length(scenes)) stop("No Landsat 8/9 scenes for this polygon and dates.")

# The Planetary Computer id omits the processing date; the complete USGS id
# is the folder that contains the files.
product_id <- function(x) basename(dirname(sub("\\?.*", "", x$assets$mtl.txt$href)))

scene_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(scenes, function(x) data.frame(
  product_id = product_id(x),
  date = substr(x$properties$datetime, 1, 10),
  satellite = x$properties$platform,
  cloud_pct = x$properties[["eo:cloud_cover"]]
)))
scene_table <- scene_table[order(scene_table$date, scene_table$product_id), ]
rownames(scene_table) <- NULL
dir.create(dest, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(scene_table, file.path(dest, "scenes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(scene_table, digits = 2)
```

## Cloud cover

`eo:cloud_cover` is the cloud percentage of the **whole scene**, not of the polygon.

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
plot(as.Date(scene_table$date), scene_table$cloud_pct, pch = 19, ylim = c(0, 100),
     xlab = "Acquisition date", ylab = "Scene cloud cover (%)")
text(as.Date(scene_table$date), scene_table$cloud_pct, labels = seq_len(nrow(scene_table)),
     pos = 3, cex = 0.7)
```

The numbers above the points are the rows of the table and of the CSV file.

## Choosing the scene

If `ids` was left empty in the first block, the document only shows the available
scenes. To download, copy the chosen **product_id** values from the table into
`ids` and render again.

```{r}
query_only <- !length(ids)
if (query_only) {
  cat("Search only. To download, assign the chosen product_id values from the table to `ids`.\n")
}
```


## Download the chosen products

```{r}
#| eval: !expr length(ids) > 0
stopifnot(all(ids %in% scene_table$product_id))
options(timeout = 3600)  # download.file stops after 60 s by default

# shortcut: the SAS token lasts ~1 h; if many scenes are downloaded, sign again for each scene.
signed <- items_sign(items, sign_planetary_computer())$features

for (x in signed) {
  id <- product_id(x)
  if (!id %in% ids) next
  folder <- file.path(dest, id)
  dir.create(folder, showWarnings = FALSE)
  for (a in x$assets) {
    name <- basename(sub("\\?.*", "", a$href))
    if (!grepl("(\\.TIF|_MTL\\.txt)$", name)) next  # bands and the txt metadata
    final <- file.path(folder, name)
    if (file.exists(final)) next
    # .part avoids leaving truncated files with the final name if the download is interrupted
    download.file(a$href, paste0(final, ".part"), mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
    file.rename(paste0(final, ".part"), final)
  }
  cat("Downloaded:", id, "-", length(list.files(folder)), "files.\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr length(ids) > 0
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6
library(terra)

folder <- file.path(dest, ids[1])
bands <- file.path(folder, paste0(ids[1], "_SR_B", c(5, 4, 3), ".TIF"))  # NIR, red, green
r <- rast(bands)
r[r == 0] <- NA  # fill value

aoi_r <- project(vect(aoi), crs(r))
zoom <- crop(r, ext(aoi_r) + 2000)  # 2 km margin around the AOI

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plotRGB(r, stretch = "lin", main = "Complete scene")
lines(aoi_r, col = "yellow", lwd = 2)
plotRGB(zoom, stretch = "lin", main = "Zoom to the AOI")
lines(aoi_r, col = "yellow", lwd = 2)
```

## Bands, scale factors and offsets

The level 2 GeoTIFF files are stored as integers. To get the physical value,
apply, for each band:

$$\text{value} = DN \times \text{factor} + \text{offset}$$

- Surface reflectance (SR_B1 to SR_B7): $\rho = DN \times 0.0000275 - 0.2$
  (unitless, valid range 0 to 1).
- Surface temperature (ST_B10): $T = DN \times 0.00341802 + 149$ (Kelvin).
- Pixels with the *Fill Value* have no data and must be masked before scaling.
- The QA bands are bit fields: they are not scaled.

The same factors apply to Landsat 8 and 9 and are also in the `*_MTL.txt` file
(`REFLECTANCE_MULT_BAND_n`, `REFLECTANCE_ADD_BAND_n`, `TEMPERATURE_MULT_BAND_ST_B10`,
`TEMPERATURE_ADD_BAND_ST_B10`). The column *PC asset* is the name of the asset in
Planetary Computer; the downloaded file is named `<product_id>_<suffix>`.

| File | PC asset | Band | Wavelength (µm) | Type | Units | Range | Fill Value | Factor | Offset |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ProductID_SR_B1 | coastal | Band 1 SR (coastal aerosol) | 0.43–0.45 | UINT16 | Reflectance | 1-65535 | 0 | 0.0000275 | -0.2 |
| ProductID_SR_B2 | blue | Band 2 SR (blue) | 0.45–0.51 | UINT16 | Reflectance | 1-65535 | 0 | 0.0000275 | -0.2 |
| ProductID_SR_B3 | green | Band 3 SR (green) | 0.53–0.59 | UINT16 | Reflectance | 1-65535 | 0 | 0.0000275 | -0.2 |
| ProductID_SR_B4 | red | Band 4 SR (red) | 0.64–0.67 | UINT16 | Reflectance | 1-65535 | 0 | 0.0000275 | -0.2 |
| ProductID_SR_B5 | nir08 | Band 5 SR (NIR) | 0.85–0.88 | UINT16 | Reflectance | 1-65535 | 0 | 0.0000275 | -0.2 |
| ProductID_SR_B6 | swir16 | Band 6 SR (SWIR 1) | 1.57–1.65 | UINT16 | Reflectance | 1-65535 | 0 | 0.0000275 | -0.2 |
| ProductID_SR_B7 | swir22 | Band 7 SR (SWIR 2) | 2.11–2.29 | UINT16 | Reflectance | 1-65535 | 0 | 0.0000275 | -0.2 |
| ProductID_ST_B10 | lwir11 | Band 10 ST (TIRS 1) | 10.60–11.19 | UINT16 | Kelvin | 1-65535 | 0 | 0.00341802 | 149 |
| ProductID_QA_PIXEL | qa_pixel | Level 2 Pixel Quality Band | NA | UINT16 | Bit Index | 1-65535 | 1 | NA | NA |
| ProductID_SR_QA_AEROSOL | qa_aerosol | Aerosol QA | NA | UINT8 | Bit Index | 0-255 | 1 | NA | NA |
| ProductID_QA_RADSAT | qa_radsat | Radiometric Saturation QA | NA | UINT16 | Bit Index | 0-65535 | NA | NA | NA |
| ProductID_ST_QA | qa | Surface Temperature Uncertainty | NA | INT16 | Kelvin | 0-32767 | -9999 | 0.01 | NA |
| ProductID_ST_TRAD | trad | Thermal Radiance | NA | INT16 | DN | 0-22000 | -9999 | 0.001 | NA |
| ProductID_ST_URAD | urad | Upwelled Radiance | NA | INT16 | DN | 0-28000 | -9999 | 0.001 | NA |
| ProductID_ST_DRAD | drad | Downwelled Radiance | NA | INT16 | DN | 0-28000 | -9999 | 0.001 | NA |
| ProductID_ST_ATRAN | atran | Atmospheric Transmittance | NA | INT16 | Unitless | 0-10000 | -9999 | 0.0001 | NA |
| ProductID_ST_EMIS | emis | Emissivity estimated from ASTER GED | NA | INT16 | Unitless | 0-10000 | -9999 | 0.0001 | NA |
| ProductID_ST_EMSD | emsd | Emissivity standard deviation | NA | INT16 | Unitless | 0-32767 | -9999 | 0.0001 | NA |
| ProductID_ST_CDIST | cdist | Pixel distance to cloud | NA | INT16 | Kilometers | 0-24000 | -9999 | 0.01 | NA |
| ProductID_MTL | mtl.txt | Level 2 Metadata file | NA | NA | NA | NA | NA | NA | NA |

Example with `terra` to convert an SR band to reflectance:

```{r}
#| eval: false
b4 <- terra::rast(list.files(file.path(dest, ids[1]), "_SR_B4\\.TIF$", full.names = TRUE))
b4[b4 == 0] <- NA
b4 <- b4 * 0.0000275 - 0.2
```
